description: Source file containing utility functions, type mappings, and resource management routines for graphics and shader handling within the ANGLE project.

methods.name: ComputeTypedIndexRange
methods.description: Calculates the range of indices, considering primitive restart if enabled.

methods.name: VariableComponentCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of components for a given GL type.

methods.name: VariableComponentType
methods.description: Returns the base component type (e.g., GL_FLOAT, GL_INT) for a given GL type.

methods.name: VariableComponentSize
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of a component for a given GL type.

methods.name: VariableInternalSize
methods.description: Returns the internal size in bytes for a variable type, expanded to 4-element vectors.

methods.name: VariableExternalSize
methods.description: Returns the external size in bytes for a variable type.

methods.name: VariableBoolVectorType
methods.description: Returns the boolean vector type corresponding to a given type.

methods.name: VariableRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows for matrix types or 1 for others.

methods.name: VariableColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns for matrix types or 1 for others.

methods.name: IsSamplerType
methods.description: Checks if a type is a sampler type.

methods.name: IsSamplerCubeType
methods.description: Checks if a type is a cube map sampler.

methods.name: IsImageType
methods.description: Checks if a type is an image type.

methods.name: IsImage2DType
methods.description: Checks if a type is a 2D image type.

methods.name: IsAtomicCounterType
methods.description: Checks if a type is an atomic counter type.

methods.name: IsOpaqueType
methods.description: Checks if a type is an opaque type (sampler, image, or atomic counter).

methods.name: IsMatrixType
methods.description: Checks if a type is a matrix type.

methods.name: TransposeMatrixType
methods.description: Returns the transposed matrix type.

methods.name: MatrixRegisterCount
methods.description: Returns the register count for a matrix type based on row/column orientation.

methods.name: MatrixComponentCount
methods.description: Returns the component count for a matrix type based on row/column orientation.

methods.name: VariableRegisterCount
methods.description: Returns the register count for a variable type.

methods.name: ComputeIndexRange
methods.description: Computes index range from index type and data, considering primitive restart.

methods.name: GetPrimitiveRestartIndex
methods.description: Returns the primitive restart index for a given index type.

methods.name: IsTriangleMode
methods.description: Checks if a primitive mode is a triangle mode.

methods.name: IsPolygonMode
methods.description: Checks if a primitive mode is a polygon mode.

methods.name: IsIntegerFormat
methods.description: Checks if a format is an integer format.

methods.name: VariableSortOrder
methods.description: Determines the packing priority order for shader variables.

methods.name: ParseResourceName
methods.description: Parses resource name, extracting subscripts.

methods.name: StripLastArrayIndex
methods.description: Removes the last array index from a resource name.

methods.name: SamplerNameContainsNonZeroArrayElement
methods.description: Checks if sampler name contains non-zero array element.

methods.name: FindShaderVarField
methods.description: Finds a shader variable field by name.

methods.name: ArraySizeProduct
methods.description: Calculates the product of array sizes.

methods.name: ParseArrayIndex
methods.description: Parses array index from resource name.

methods.name: GetGenericErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns a string message for a GL or EGL error code.

methods.name: ElementTypeSize
methods.description: Returns size in bytes of an element type.

methods.name: GetPipelineType
methods.description: Returns pipeline type based on shader type.

methods.name: EGLClientBufferToGLObjectHandle
methods.description: Converts EGL client buffer to GL object handle.

methods.name: GLComponentTypeToEGLColorComponentType
methods.description: Converts GL component type to EGL color component type.

methods.name: GLObjectHandleToEGLClientBuffer
methods.description: Converts GL object handle to EGL client buffer.

methods.name: IsCubeMapTextureTarget
methods.description: Checks if target is a cube map texture target.

methods.name: LayerIndexToCubeMapTextureTarget
methods.description: Converts layer index to cube map texture target.

methods.name: CubeMapTextureTargetToLayerIndex
methods.description: Converts cube map texture target to layer index.

methods.name: IsTextureTarget
methods.description: Checks if target is a texture target.

methods.name: IsRenderbufferTarget
methods.description: Checks if target is a renderbuffer target.

methods.name: IsExternalImageTarget
methods.description: Checks if target is an external image target.

methods.name: GetGenericErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns a string message for EGL error code.

methods.name: ScheduleYield
methods.description: Yields the thread's execution on Windows.
